# Learning wiki map

<!-- generated by python3 tools/wiki.py map; edit the sources, not this file -->

Everything OpenDesigner has learned from the sources its owner trusts, and where each piece feeds the app. Start here when you want to understand a concept, check why the app does something, or improve an area. How the knowledge is made and updated: [README.md](README.md). How it may be used: [../docs/KNOWLEDGE.md](../docs/KNOWLEDGE.md). How to turn it into app changes: [IMPROVING.md](IMPROVING.md).

## At a glance

- **Sources:** 99 analysed (6 good-to-have, 40 non-negotiable, 53 reference), listed in [sources.json](sources.json); citations in [../traces/L19-trace.md](../traces/L19-trace.md).
- **Extracted:** 2768 rules, 601 decisions, 686 process steps, 802 examples ([analysis/](analysis/), one file per source).
- **Wiki:** 99 source pages, 50 topics, 49 synthesis pages ([wiki/index.md](wiki/index.md)).
- **House standards:** 455 rules in 11 themes, version 1 ([../synthesis/standards.json](../synthesis/standards.json)).
- **Decision Cards:** 164 in [wiki/synthesis/_cards/](wiki/synthesis/_cards/) (assembled into [../research/L19-learning-wiki.md](../research/L19-learning-wiki.md)).
- **Impact notes:** "Now / As it grows" for 30 high-impact questions ([../synthesis/impact.json](../synthesis/impact.json)).
- **Process:** [Decide or ask](wiki/synthesis/decide-or-ask.md) · [Citation check](wiki/synthesis/citation-check.md) · [House standards](wiki/synthesis/house-standards.md)

## Decision Cards

Reference sources turned into decisions the interview can ask better. Each card says which question it improves.

### color ([_cards/color.md](wiki/synthesis/_cards/color.md))

- DC-L19-01: What carries color on a screen
- DC-L19-02: Light-mode page and card arrangement
- DC-L19-03: How much hue the grays and backgrounds carry
- DC-L19-04: Spacing between dark-mode background shades
- DC-L19-05: How raised surfaces stand out in dark mode
- DC-L19-06: Which shade of the accent does each job, in light and dark
- DC-L19-07: Which way colors move on hover and press
- DC-L19-08: How many text colors, and how far from pure black and white
- DC-L19-09: What draws the edge of a card: an opaque gray line or a see-through ring
- DC-L19-10: Chart colors for several series
- DC-L19-11: Where the first color comes from when there is no brand color
- DC-L19-12: Where gradients and texture are allowed
- DC-L19-13: Color-tinted versions of the same design
- DC-L19-14: Which appearances ship, and which one is the default
- DC-L19-15: What outside the page has to follow the theme
- DC-L19-16: What the switch between light and dark looks like
- DC-L19-17: What changes when someone turns on Increase Contrast or Reduce Transparency

### typography ([_cards/typography.md](wiki/synthesis/_cards/typography.md))

- DC-L19-21: Letter spacing by role, size and case → Q-type-13
- DC-L19-22: Line height falls as size rises, with no inversions → Q-type-11
- DC-L19-23: How heading, subheading and paragraph are told apart
- DC-L19-24: Weight budget: how many weights, and how far apart
- DC-L19-25: Size budget per surface: how many sizes, and how big
- DC-L19-26: Giant display text as a visual element
- DC-L19-27: The second typeface's job
- DC-L19-28: Setting up an open font: variable file, display cut, letter alternates, fallback
- DC-L19-29: Measure for paragraphs and headings, set in characters
- DC-L19-30: How headings and short text break across lines
- DC-L19-31: Which text sizes follow the screen width
- DC-L19-32: Text size on phones and inside form fields
- DC-L19-33: Key numbers: style, alignment, label and context
- DC-L19-34: How type choices are previewed: true size, in context
- DC-L19-35: Sample content in previews: realistic, with stress cases
- DC-L19-36: Marketing copy: length and focus
- DC-L19-37: Where playfulness belongs, and never at the user
- DC-L19-38: Naming navigation, actions and screens
- DC-L19-39: Typographic punctuation in interface text

- DC-L19-41: Proximity ladder inside a content block

- DC-L19-43: How list rows are separated
- DC-L19-44: Edge-built alignment inside compact components

### shape-depth ([_cards/shape-depth.md](wiki/synthesis/_cards/shape-depth.md))

- DC-L19-61: Corner radius for images, screenshots and chart bars
- DC-L19-62: Nested corners: pills, wide gaps, flush edges and stacked containers

## Where each part lands in the app

| Knowledge | Becomes | Built by | The app uses it in |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-negotiable sources | `synthesis/standards.json` | the `learn-standards` workflow, `wiki.py standards --bump` | `engine.py init` (locked values), `review` (code checks), DESIGN.md, `references/standards/` |
| Reference sources | Decision Cards, topic pages | the `learn-synthesis` workflow | `research/L19-learning-wiki.md` → `cards/L19.json` ("why?" answers), proposed questionnaire changes (Part B) |
| Impact notes | `synthesis/impact.json` | the `learn-synthesis` workflow (process step) | `references/questions.json` and stage files: Now / As it grows under each option |
| Process pages | `wiki/synthesis/decide-or-ask.md` | the `learn-synthesis` workflow | `rules.md` section 6, "Decide or ask" |
| Everything | `learn/wiki/` | `wiki.py ingest`, `map` | people and agents reading, `jev_nav.py find` (standards) |
